notes.title: Avatar Update
notes.content:
[p]Avatar photos have been added for profiles now that I've finished the game.

I don't know if steam will allow it to work as of now, but I'm currently contacting steamworks support to help me set up the game, it's final price, and the title change for the game.

The new game will remain free until that is all set up and done with.

Thank you all for waiting as I continued to work on my games![/p]

notes.title: Complete Remake
notes.content: I remade the entire game from scratch. Nothing is the same anymore, and the title of the game was changed too.
